list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT n AS __text, n AS __value FROM (
  SELECT e.DisplayName AS n
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Node'
  UNION
  SELECT h.DisplayName
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Service'
) x
ORDER BY 1

title: Failover Clustering - Overview

targets.rawSql:
WITH nodes AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName, nv.HealthState, nv.StateLastModified
  FROM (SELECT v.DisplayName FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
        WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Node'
        UNION
        SELECT LEFT(s.Path, CHARINDEX(';', s.Path + ';') - 1) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView s JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView st ON st.Id = s.MonitoringClassId
        WHERE s.IsDeleted = 0 AND st.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Service' AND s.Path IS NOT NULL) h
  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(v.HealthState) AS HealthState, MAX(v.StateLastModified) AS StateLastModified FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Node' AND v.DisplayName = h.DisplayName) nv
  WHERE h.DisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
),
nh AS (
  SELECT n.DisplayName AS host, n.HealthState AS node_hs, n.StateLastModified AS since, sv.hs AS svc_hs, hb.hs AS hb_hs,
         (SELECT MAX(x) FROM (VALUES (n.HealthState), (sv.hs), (hb.hs)) q(x)) AS worst
  FROM nodes n
  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(s.HealthState) AS hs FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView s JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView st ON st.Id = s.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE s.IsDeleted = 0 AND st.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Service' AND LEFT(s.Path, CHARINDEX(';', s.Path + ';') - 1) = n.DisplayName) sv
  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(w.HealthState) AS hs FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView w JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView wt ON wt.Id = w.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE w.IsDeleted = 0 AND wt.Name = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher' AND w.DisplayName = n.DisplayName) hb
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster') AS "Clusters",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nh) AS "Cluster nodes",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nh WHERE worst IN (2, 3)) AS "Nodes not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g.Id, g.HealthState FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView gt ON gt.Id = g.MonitoringClassId WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND gt.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group') x) AS "Cluster groups",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g.Id, g.HealthState FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView gt ON gt.Id = g.MonitoringClassId WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND gt.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group') x WHERE x.HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "Cluster groups not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
   WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ((a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.%Cluster%' AND (LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ',')) OR NULLIF(a.MonitoringObjectPath, '') IS NULL))
       OR (a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' AND a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))))) AS "Open Failover Clustering alerts"

  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(v.HealthState) AS HealthState, MAX(v.StateLastModified) AS StateLastModified FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Node' AND v.DisplayName = h.DisplayName) nv
  WHERE h.DisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
),
nh AS (
  SELECT n.DisplayName AS host, n.HealthState AS node_hs, n.StateLastModified AS since, sv.hs AS svc_hs, hb.hs AS hb_hs,
         (SELECT MAX(x) FROM (VALUES (n.HealthState), (sv.hs), (hb.hs)) q(x)) AS worst
  FROM nodes n
  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(s.HealthState) AS hs FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView s JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView st ON st.Id = s.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE s.IsDeleted = 0 AND st.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Service' AND LEFT(s.Path, CHARINDEX(';', s.Path + ';') - 1) = n.DisplayName) sv
  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(w.HealthState) AS hs FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView w JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView wt ON wt.Id = w.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE w.IsDeleted = 0 AND wt.Name = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher' AND w.DisplayName = n.DisplayName) hb
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster') AS "Clusters",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nh) AS "Cluster nodes",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nh WHERE worst IN (2, 3)) AS "Nodes not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g.Id, g.HealthState FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView gt ON gt.Id = g.MonitoringClassId WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND gt.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group') x) AS "Cluster groups",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g.Id, g.HealthState FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView gt ON gt.Id = g.MonitoringClassId WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND gt.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group') x WHERE x.HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "Cluster groups not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
   WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ((a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.%Cluster%' AND (LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ',')) OR NULLIF(a.MonitoringObjectPath, '') IS NULL))
       OR (a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' AND a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))))) AS "Open Failover Clustering alerts"

panels.title: Open alerts

panels.description: Health is the worst of the node, its Cluster Service and its agent heartbeat. A node that is powered off turns the agent heartbeat Critical after about five minutes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH nodes AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName, nv.HealthState, nv.StateLastModified
  FROM (SELECT v.DisplayName FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
        WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Node'
        UNION
        SELECT LEFT(s.Path, CHARINDEX(';', s.Path + ';') - 1) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView s JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView st ON st.Id = s.MonitoringClassId
        WHERE s.IsDeleted = 0 AND st.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Service' AND s.Path IS NOT NULL) h
  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(v.HealthState) AS HealthState, MAX(v.StateLastModified) AS StateLastModified FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Node' AND v.DisplayName = h.DisplayName) nv
  WHERE h.DisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
),
nh AS (
  SELECT n.DisplayName AS host, n.HealthState AS node_hs, n.StateLastModified AS since, sv.hs AS svc_hs, hb.hs AS hb_hs,
         (SELECT MAX(x) FROM (VALUES (n.HealthState), (sv.hs), (hb.hs)) q(x)) AS worst
  FROM nodes n
  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(s.HealthState) AS hs FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView s JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView st ON st.Id = s.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE s.IsDeleted = 0 AND st.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Service' AND LEFT(s.Path, CHARINDEX(';', s.Path + ';') - 1) = n.DisplayName) sv
  OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(w.HealthState) AS hs FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView w JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView wt ON wt.Id = w.MonitoringClassId
               WHERE w.IsDeleted = 0 AND wt.Name = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher' AND w.DisplayName = n.DisplayName) hb
)
SELECT TOP 200 host AS Host, CASE worst WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Health, CASE svc_hs WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Cluster service", CASE hb_hs WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Agent heartbeat", CASE node_hs WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Node", since AS LastStateChange
FROM nh ORDER BY CASE worst WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, host

panels.title: Cluster nodes (click a node for detail)

panels.description: Every failover cluster SCOM has discovered. A cluster or group shows Not monitored until the management pack has evaluated its monitors.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 200 c.DisplayName AS Cluster, CASE c.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Health,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.Id) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView gt ON gt.Id = g.MonitoringClassId
    WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND gt.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group' AND (g.DisplayName LIKE '% (' + c.DisplayName + ')' OR g.DisplayName LIKE c.DisplayName + '.%')) AS "Cluster groups",
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.Id) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView gt ON gt.Id = g.MonitoringClassId
    WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND gt.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group' AND (g.DisplayName LIKE '% (' + c.DisplayName + ')' OR g.DisplayName LIKE c.DisplayName + '.%') AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "Groups not healthy"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT v.Id, v.DisplayName, v.HealthState FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
      WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster') c
ORDER BY CASE c.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, c.DisplayName

panels.title: Clusters

panels.description: The cluster groups of every discovered cluster, worst first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 1000 g.ClusterName AS Cluster, g.GroupName AS "Cluster group", CASE g.hs WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Health, g.since AS LastStateChange
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT v.Id, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(' (', v.DisplayName) > 0 AND RIGHT(v.DisplayName, 1) = ')' THEN SUBSTRING(v.DisplayName, CHARINDEX(' (', v.DisplayName) + 2, LEN(v.DisplayName) - CHARINDEX(' (', v.DisplayName) - 2) ELSE LEFT(v.DisplayName, CHARINDEX('.', v.DisplayName + '.') - 1) END AS ClusterName,
             CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(' (', v.DisplayName) > 0 AND RIGHT(v.DisplayName, 1) = ')' THEN LEFT(v.DisplayName, CHARINDEX(' (', v.DisplayName) - 1) ELSE SUBSTRING(v.DisplayName, CHARINDEX('.', v.DisplayName + '.') + 1, 400) END AS GroupName, v.HealthState AS hs, v.StateLastModified AS since
      FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId
      WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group') g
ORDER BY CASE g.hs WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, g.ClusterName, g.GroupName

panels.title: Cluster groups

panels.description: Warning and Critical monitors on the cluster objects and the agent heartbeat of the selected nodes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  CASE WHEN e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' THEN e.DisplayName ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(e.Path, CHARINDEX(';', e.Path + ';') - 1), ''), '(cluster)') END AS Host,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3) AND e.IsDeleted = 0
  AND s.MonitorName NOT IN ('System.Health.EntityState', 'System.Health.AvailabilityState', 'System.Health.ConfigurationState', 'System.Health.PerformanceState', 'System.Health.SecurityState')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1) OR s.MonitorName = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService.Heartbeat')
  AND ((e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.%Cluster%' AND (LEFT(e.Path, CHARINDEX(';', e.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ',')) OR NULLIF(e.Path, '') IS NULL))
       OR (e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' AND e.DisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))))
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC

panels.title: Unhealthy cluster monitors

panels.description: Open alerts in the selected time range. Alerts on the cluster itself or its groups belong to no single node, so they are listed whichever nodes are selected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  a.Severity AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  CASE WHEN a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' THEN a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1), ''), '(cluster)') END AS Host,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ((a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.%Cluster%' AND (LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ',')) OR NULLIF(a.MonitoringObjectPath, '') IS NULL))
       OR (a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher%' AND a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))))
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC
